name: AI EvalGod Observability & Causal Analysis
description: Framework-agnostic OpenTelemetry tracing, causal trajectory DAG reconstruction, root-cause blame attribution, and regression quality gating for OpenClaw agents.
author: Antigravity AI Systems

endpoint.description: Base URL of the running Ai_EvalGod evaluation and observability server

agentId.description: Identifier for the active OpenClaw agent instance

agentVersion.description: Semantic version of the active OpenClaw agent

autoTrace.description: Automatically capture and export OpenTelemetry spans for all agent tool calls and messages

minScoreThreshold.description: Minimum acceptable trajectory score for CI/CD regression gates

tools.name: aieval_get_health
tools.description: Retrieve live agent health metrics, success rates, latency, token spend, and tool usage frequencies.

tools.name: aieval_analyze_root_cause
tools.description: Analyze an agent execution trace, reconstruct its causal trajectory DAG, and pinpoint the primary root cause behind cascading errors.

tools.name: aieval_compare_golden_path
tools.description: Compare an agent execution tool sequence against an expected golden path benchmark.

tools.name: aieval_gate_check
tools.description: Evaluate an agent experiment against baseline regression datasets and enforce a PASS / BLOCK CI gate.
